info.name: CreatorConnect - Project Service
info.description:
Project Service CRUD APIs.

Base URL: http://localhost:8083 (direct) or http://localhost:8080 (via API Gateway — same paths).

Setup:
1. Register + login via the Auth Service to obtain a JWT.
2. Paste the token into the collection variable `jwtToken` (or use the Swagger/Postman Bearer auth tab).
3. After creating a project, copy its `id` from the response into the collection variable `projectId`.

Endpoints:
- POST   /projects            Create project (userId taken from JWT)
- GET    /projects            Get all projects (browse feed — optional filters: category, skill, budgetMin/budgetMax, experienceLevel, location, keyword)
- GET    /projects/my         Get my projects (same optional filters)
- GET    /projects/{id}       Get project by id
- PUT    /projects/{id}       Update project (owner only)
- DELETE /projects/{id}       Delete project (owner only)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "YouTube Intro Package",
  "description": "Need a 15-second animated intro for a new YouTube channel. Looking for a motion designer with a strong portfolio.",
  "category": "Video Editing",
  "skillsRequired": ["After Effects", "Motion Design"],
  "budget": 500.00,
  "duration": "1 week",
  "experienceLevel": "Intermediate",
  "location": "Remote",
  "applicationDeadline": "2026-09-30"
}

request.description: Creates a project for the authenticated user. The owning userId is read from the JWT — never from the body. Fields marked required: title, description, category, budget, duration, experienceLevel, applicationDeadline. skillsRequired, location and status are optional (status defaults to OPEN).

query.description: A skill the project must require — substring match (case-insensitive). Optional.
Substring match on title or description (case-insensitive). Optional.

request.description: Returns the project feed, most recently created first. Any authenticated user may browse. Every query parameter is optional and combinable — active filters are ANDed together and evaluated in the database. Delete any parameter you don't want to filter by.

Returns every project owned by the authenticated user (userId from the JWT), most recently created first. Accepts the same optional filters as the browse feed (category, skill, budgetMin/budgetMax, experienceLevel, location, keyword).
Returns a single project by its id (UUID). Any authenticated user may view any project. Returns 404 when the project does not exist.

Partially updates the project with the given id. Only the authenticated owner may update it (403 otherwise). Fields omitted from the body are unchanged. Status values: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.
Deletes the project with the given id. Only the authenticated owner may delete it (403 otherwise). Returns 200 with a null data payload on success.
